---
title: "About"
subtitle: "Why product management."
---

I started in **computer science** because I wanted to understand how technology is built. **Data science** taught me how to measure what is happening and test whether an idea is actually working. My **MBA** added the business side: how products create value, how organizations make tradeoffs, and how teams turn strategy into execution.

**Product management is where those pieces come together for me.**

My experience has included building software for the Los Angeles Dodgers, managing database and cloud infrastructure, leading project work for the Marion Berries Baseball Club's inaugural season, evaluating early-stage companies through angel and venture investing, and developing products of my own.

I enjoy ambiguous problems more than perfectly defined ones. I like talking with users, understanding the workflow behind a request, getting close enough to the technical details to ask useful questions, and using data to decide what matters most.

My goal is to keep developing as a product leader who can move comfortably between engineering, analytics, design, customers, and business strategy without losing sight of the outcome the team is trying to create.
